text: Corrected the semantic direction in aa06e60: every base objective now retains typed feature-space second-order operators as SelfCompressionExpression or CrossCompressionExpression and derives W*SW only from a supplied candidate frame. Frame normalization now has the same feature-space covariance orientation. Verified multivar JVM+JS 291/291 and multivar-ir JVM 12/12, JS 10/10.
